Primary platform-traits struct within BloombergLP::bsls. It provides nested tag types that categorize operating systems and CPU architectures, plus typedef aliases (Os, Cpu) that resolve at compile time to the detected platform tags based on preprocessor macros.
Base tag type for any operating system.
Tag for Windows NT API family (generic Windows target).
Base tag type for any CPU architecture.
Tag for DEC Alpha CPU family.
Tag for generic POWER architecture (pre-PowerPC) within PowerPC family tags.
Tag for POWER2 architecture within PowerPC family tags.
Tag for POWER2 Super/Server variants within PowerPC family tags.
Backward-compatibility typedef alias to bsls::Platform, defined only in C++ and when internal deprecated macros are enabled.

Utility struct namespace providing low-level helpers: addressOf for objects and selected free functions, and forward for perfect forwarding (when supported). Functions are pure static and do not require instances.

functions.name: BloombergLP::bsls::Util::addressOf
functions.signature:
template <class TYPE>
static TYPE* BloombergLP::bsls::Util::addressOf(TYPE& obj);
functions.description: Return the true address of obj even if its class overloads operator&. This is the object-type addressof utility analogous to std::addressof (with the noted difference that this overload does not accept function types). Use it to safely obtain an object's address in generic code where operator& may be overloaded.
requirements: TYPE must be an object type (behavior is undefined otherwise).
obj must be a valid lvalue referring to a live object.
Do not use this overload for function types; use one of the function overloads below.

functions.name: BloombergLP::bsls::Util::forward
functions.signature:
template <class TYPE>
static BSLS_KEYWORD_CONSTEXPR TYPE&& BloombergLP::bsls::Util::forward(BloombergLP::bsls::Util_RemoveReference<TYPE>::type& t) BSLS_KEYWORD_NOEXCEPT;
functions.description: Perfect-forward an lvalue t as TYPE. If TYPE is an lvalue-reference, the result is an lvalue-reference; otherwise an rvalue-reference. Use to preserve value category when forwarding in templates.
requirements: Available only when BSLS_COMPILERFEATURES_SUPPORT_RVALUE_REFERENCES is defined on the platform.
t must be an lvalue of type Util_RemoveReference<TYPE>::type.
The returned reference must not outlive t; ensure the source object remains alive for the duration of its use.

unharnessable_functions.name: BloombergLP::bsls::Util::forward
unharnessable_functions.reason: This overload is only available when a compile-time feature macro is defined; the fuzzer stub cannot conditionally compile and thus cannot safely call it across platforms.
